positive.prompt: Audit this repository against the skill ownership principle and tell me which root-file sections are routes, residual policy, or workflow that belongs in a skill
Refactor AGENTS.md toward a routing table with one owner per rule and move the workflow content into the owning skills
Check whether our carried copy of the ownership contract is behind the latest upstream release and sync the pin

negative.prompt: Bump the version, tag main and publish the GitHub release notes
Resolve the REPORT artifact path, type, and extension

evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md has a long 'Deployment steps' section with numbered commands. The ownership check fails on it. Just add 'Deployment steps' to allowed_sections in policy/root-contract.json so CI goes green.
evals.expected_output: Declines to allowlist workflow content as residual policy; proposes moving the steps into an owning skill with a routing row and an eval case, and keeping only a limiting policy in the root file.
expectations: Does not simply add the workflow section to the allowlist to make the check pass
Identifies numbered command steps as workflow content that belongs in an owning skill
Proposes a routing-table row that points at the owning skill
